import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If all p-values > 0.05, claim no mechanism
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05 and strong effect
    significant_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if p_values[i] < 0.05:
            col_idx = feats.column(fid)
            x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
            y = feats.y
            effect = np.mean(x[y==1]) - np.mean(x[y==0])
            significant_features.append((fid, abs(effect), p_values[i]))
    
    # Sort by effect size (descending)
    significant_features.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features as potential drivers
    drivers = tuple(f[0] for f in significant_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # For logistic regression, include all significant features but limit
    columns = tuple(f[0] for f in significant_features[:5])  # Top 5
    
    # Create interaction terms for top features (if enough)
    products = []
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        # Only include interactions between top 3 drivers
        top_drivers = drivers[:3]
        for i in range(len(top_drivers)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(top_drivers)):
                products.append((top_drivers[i], top_drivers[j]))
    
    # Weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for fid in drivers[:3]:  # Top 3
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        effect = np.mean(x[y==1]) - np.mean(x[y==0])
        loadings[fid] = effect
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
